description: This file defines types and functions related to managing the state of pending tool calls within an agent or session context. It includes a type for representing individual tool calls, another for managing the collection of pending calls with various utility methods, and a factory function to create instances of this state.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of pending tool calls.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Returns an iterator of key-value pairs in the pending calls map.

methods.name: getToolName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the tool associated with a given ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a pending call by its ID.

methods.name: trackToolCalls
methods.description: Adds multiple tool calls to the pending list.

methods.name: getPendingIds
methods.description: Returns an array of all pending tool call IDs.

methods.name: shouldFlushForSanitizedDrop
methods.description: Determines if pending calls should be flushed in case of sanitized drop, based on whether there are pending calls.

methods.name: shouldFlushBeforeNonToolResult
methods.description: Decides if pending calls should be flushed before generating a non-tool result, based on the role and number of calls.

methods.name: shouldFlushBeforeNewToolCalls
methods.description: Decides if pending calls should be flushed before new tool calls are added.

ctags.name: PendingToolCall
ctags.pattern: /^export type PendingToolCall = { id: string; name?: string };$/

ctags.name: pending
ctags.pattern: /^  const pending = new Map<string, string | undefined>();$/
